title: Ember's First Flame
blurb: A little dragon who cannot make fire learns that giggles and friends can light up a whole castle.
cast: Ember, a small cute red dragon with tiny wings and a round belly; Tobin, a young castle squire wearing a shiny helmet that is too big for him
coverArt: A small cute red dragon with tiny wings smiling beside a young squire in an oversized helmet in a warm torch-lit stone castle hall

pages.art: Ember the small red dragon sitting in a big stone castle hall with torches along the walls

text.2: Ember is a little dragon. She lives in a castle.
text.3: Ember is a little red dragon with tiny wings. She lives in Dragon's Keep, a big stone castle full of torches.
text.4: Ember is a little red dragon with tiny wings and a round belly. She lives in Dragon's Keep, a huge stone castle where torches glow along every wall.

pages.art: Big grown-up dragons breathing fire to light torches while little Ember watches

text.2: The big dragons make fire. Whoosh!
text.3: Every dragon in the keep can breathe fire to light the torches. Whoosh! It is the family job.
text.4: Every dragon in the keep can breathe fire to light the torches at night. Whoosh! Whoosh! It is the family job, and everyone says Ember will do it soon.

pages.art: Ember taking a huge breath with puffed cheeks and blowing out sparkles and bubbles instead of fire

text.2: Ember tries. Out come... sparkles!
text.3: Ember takes a giant breath and blows. But no fire comes out. Only a puff of sparkles!
text.4: Ember takes the biggest breath of her whole life and blows. But no fire comes out. Only a puff of sparkly, glittery bubbles floats into the air.

pages.art: Other young dragons giggling kindly while Ember looks embarrassed with pink cheeks

text.2: Ember feels bad. She wants real fire.
text.3: The other dragons giggle. Ember's cheeks turn pink. She wants real fire, just like them.
text.4: The other dragons giggle, though not unkindly. Ember's cheeks turn pink anyway. She wants to make real fire more than anything in the world.

pages.art: Ember sitting alone on a high castle wall at dusk with unlit torches in the courtyard far below

text.2: Ember goes out alone. The sun is going down.
text.3: Ember walks out to the high wall and sits alone. The sun is going down, and the torches below are still dark.
text.4: Ember slips away to the high castle wall and sits all alone. The sun is sinking, and she notices that down in the courtyard, the torches are still dark.

pages.art: Tobin the squire in an oversized helmet waving up at Ember from the courtyard

text.2: "Hello!" says a boy. His helmet is too big!
text.3: "Hello up there!" calls a boy in a helmet that is much too big. "I am Tobin! Are you okay?"
text.4: "Hello up there!" calls a boy in a shiny helmet that is much too big for him. "I am Tobin, the new squire! Are you okay? You look sad."

pages.art: A stone courtyard where every torch is unlit, cold blue evening, breath showing in the air

text.2: It is cold in the keep. The torches are out!
text.3: That night, the wind blows through the keep and puts out all the torches. It gets cold and dark.
text.4: That night, a wild wind sweeps through Dragon's Keep and blows out every single torch. The halls grow cold and dark, and everyone is shivering.

pages.art: Big dragons in blankets coughing little gray smoke rings, sick with a cold

text.2: The big dragons are sick. They cannot make fire.
text.3: The big dragons have all caught a cold. When they try to breathe fire, they can only cough.
text.4: Worse still, the big dragons have all caught a cold. When they try to light the torches, they can only cough, and tiny gray smoke rings drift out.

pages.art: Tobin handing Ember an unlit torch, encouraging her with a big smile

text.2: Tobin has a plan. "You can do it, Ember!"
text.3: "You can do it, Ember!" says Tobin. "Just try, even if it is a little bit."
text.4: "I think you can do it, Ember," says Tobin. "You do not have to be perfect. Just try, even if it is only a little bit."

pages.art: Ember taking a slow breath as a tiny orange spark pops out of her nose

text.2: Ember tries again. A tiny spark pops out!
text.3: Ember breathes in slowly. Pop! A tiny orange spark flies out and then disappears.
text.4: Ember breathes in slowly and thinks of something warm. Pop! A tiny orange spark jumps out, flickers for a second, and then fades away.

pages.art: Tobin cheering and jumping with his helmet slipping over his eyes, Ember looking surprised

text.2: "A spark!" says Tobin. "Do it again!"
text.3: "A spark! You did make a spark!" cheers Tobin. "That is the start of fire!"
text.4: "A spark!" cheers Tobin, jumping up and down so hard his helmet slips over his eyes. "That is how every fire starts, Ember. Just one little spark!"

pages.art: Ember smiling with determination in the dim night castle

text.2: Ember smiles. She will keep trying.
text.3: For the first time all day, Ember smiles. She will keep trying until the keep is warm again.
text.4: For the first time all day, Ember smiles. She is not done yet. She will keep on trying until the whole keep is warm again.

pages.art: Ember puffing out a little cloud of gray smoke while Tobin holds an unlit torch

text.2: Ember tries. Puff! Only smoke.
text.3: Ember tries again. Puff! This time she makes a little cloud of smoke. It is closer, but it is not fire.
text.4: Ember tries again. Puff! This time she makes a little gray cloud of smoke. It is closer than before, but it is still not fire.

pages.art: Ember scrunching her face as a bigger spark lands on a torch and Tobin ducks

text.2: Pop! A spark lands on the torch. It goes out.
text.3: Pop! A bigger spark lands on the torch, glows for a moment, and goes out. "Almost!" says Tobin.
text.4: Pop! A bigger spark lands on the torch and glows for a moment, but a draft puffs it out. "Almost!" says Tobin. "That was so close!"

pages.art: Ember slumped and tired while Tobin sits beside her sharing warm bread

text.2: Ember is tired. Tobin shares his bread.
text.3: Ember feels tired and a little bit grumpy. Tobin sits next to her and shares his warm bread.
text.4: Ember feels tired and a little bit grumpy. Tobin sits next to her and shares his warm bread. "Resting is part of trying," he says.

pages.art: Tobin making a very silly face with his tongue out and helmet on sideways, Ember starting to giggle

text.2: Tobin makes a silly face. Ember giggles.
text.3: Tobin makes his silliest face, with his tongue out and his helmet on sideways. Ember starts to giggle.
text.4: Tobin pulls his silliest face, with his tongue out and his helmet on sideways. Ember bursts out giggling, and she cannot stop.

pages.art: Ember giggling with a small warm flame hiccuping out of her mouth, surprised

text.2: She giggles. Hic! A little flame comes out!
text.3: Ember giggles so hard that she hiccups. And out of her mouth pops a real little flame!
text.4: Ember giggles so hard that she gets the hiccups. Hic! And out of her mouth pops a real, warm, flickering little flame, the first one ever.

pages.art: Ember and Tobin staring in amazement at a small flame floating in the air between them

text.2: Fire! Ember made fire!
text.3: They both stare at the flame. "Fire!" they shout together. "Ember, you made fire!"
text.4: They both stare at the little flame dancing in the air. "Fire!" they shout together. "Ember, you made fire! It was giggles, not trying!"

pages.art: Ember lighting the first torch with a gentle golden flame while Tobin watches

text.2: Ember lights the first torch. Whoosh!
text.3: Ember aims carefully at the first torch and giggles again. Whoosh! The torch lights with a warm glow.
text.4: Ember aims carefully at the first torch and thinks of Tobin's silly face. Whoosh! A warm, golden flame leaps out and lights the torch.

pages.art: Ember and Tobin running down a long hall lighting torches one by one with warm glow spreading

text.2: They run down the hall. Light, light, light!
text.3: They run all down the hall together. Ember lights one torch after another while Tobin cheers.
text.4: They run all the way down the great hall together. Ember lights one torch after another, and Tobin cheers as the keep glows brighter at every step.

pages.art: The big dragons waking up and smiling in the warm torchlight

text.2: The big dragons wake up. They feel warm.
text.3: The warm light wakes up the big dragons. They stretch and smile, and their colds feel a little better.
text.4: The warm light wakes the big dragons, and they stretch and smile. The glow makes their sore throats feel better already.

pages.art: Ember's mom and dad dragons giving Ember a proud hug

text.2: Mom and Dad are proud. They hug Ember.
text.3: Ember's mom and dad give her a great big hug. "We are so proud of you," they say.
text.4: Ember's mom and dad wrap her in a great big hug. "We are so proud of you," they say. "You did not give up, and that is what matters most."

pages.art: A cozy feast table in the great hall with Ember and Tobin seated side by side and candles glowing

text.2: Time to eat! Ember sits with Tobin.
text.3: The whole castle has a feast to say thank you. Ember sits right next to her new friend Tobin.
text.4: The whole castle holds a feast that night to say thank you. Ember gets the seat of honor, and she insists that Tobin sit right next to her.

pages.art: Ember and Tobin sitting on the high castle wall at night with the warm lit castle windows glowing below and stars above

text.2: The keep is warm and bright. Good night!
text.3: Ember and Tobin look out from the high wall. The whole keep glows below. "Good night, Dragon's Keep," says Ember.
text.4: Ember and Tobin sit on the high wall and look at the glowing keep below them. "Good night, Dragon's Keep," says Ember. "Tomorrow, I will do it again."
